title: A mid morning walk in the hills around Alambra.
text:
We met near the main fountain and the guide took time to plan a structured  walk around Albecein and Sacramento.
It was one of the highlights of our trip so far and would suggest this walk if wanting  a history lesson on a fantastic region.
author: rod y

title: Highly recommended
text: Ruben gave us a great, informative and interesting tour. He also gave us extra tips to make the most of our visit.

title: Fantastic tour. Highly recommend it.
text: Juanjo was an excellent tour guide. He was extremely knowledgeable and absolutely delightful. He gave us a tremendous historical background. A true history buff. It was a great experience. Thank you Juanjo!
author: susana_h

title: Very very good!
text:
It was our first visit to Granada and so we signed up for the Granada Essentials Free Tour (center) at very short notice. Our guide Sabina was so great, dedicated and the tour was so entertaining and interesting that it flew by. We were so excited that we immediately booked the Albaicín and Sacromonte Free Tour for the afternoon.
Again, we were not disappointed: Marta was phenomenal, competent and very charming.
An absolute recommendation!!!
author: WolfgangK007

title: Must do in Granada

title: Sacromonte! Nacho!
text: We were a group of four friends to discover the deep Sacromonte. Being Grenadines there were areas that we had never travelled through and certainly many others that we did not know about in history. Nacho, the guide, made us feel at home, very close, very well formed and loving what he does. The route is comfortable to do, just be sure to bring proper shoes and water, the rest is to enjoy fascinating views and history. See you soon!
author: Teresa P
